findings.evidence: Original actual world-space external DNA cylinder endpoints have consecutive-edge scalar triple products consistently -2.01480598966e-6. The same sign convention on experimentally right-handed 1BNA phosphate samples with stride 3 gives +5245.50 to +5726.06. This is a world-space geometric reflection, not camera orientation. Both current backbones give +2.01480598966e-6 after correction.
findings.whyWrong: The environmental DNA duplex was drawn with left-handed helicity without a Z-DNA or other exceptional conformational scope. The natural-transformation model calls for an ordinary right-handed duplex.
findings.fix: Reflect only the transverse cosine component of the environmental duplex frame, preserving positive separation, strand identities and the fixed uptake-mouth endpoint. Add the primary B-DNA structural reference.
findings.verification: Actual-world endpoint handedness test for both strands, and a negative-control reflection that the same check rejects. Independent baseline/current/1BNA reference measurements stored alongside the audit.

findings.location: Labels for environmental DNA, ComEC, DprA/RecA, fragments and chromosome
findings.evidence: At p=.525 the ComEC label leader terminates below the drawn pore; RecA and chromosome labels use old free-space locations. At p=.575 the environmental DNA label remains active after all extracellular DNA segments disappear. Baseline-to-target measurement: 0.7830229881682913 world units; corrected gap 0.
findings.whyWrong: label.position is consumed as the leader endpoint. A named-object annotation must identify its actual geometry; stale text-layout offsets and absent-object labels misleadingly identify empty regions or other structures.
findings.fix: Anchor labels to actual external DNA, ComEC rim, DprA/RecA proteins, fragments, chromosome and heteroduplex. Hide labels without visible objects. The no-homology outcome explicitly refers to the retained chromosome and anchors there after imported DNA degradation.
findings.verification: 208 both-condition geometry/label states and repeated seeks; actual-world target comparisons and six negative controls. Existing scientific geometry regressions retained.
